The issuer displays significant financial distress, characterized by a net loss of $139 million on $9.29 billion in revenue and an extremely thin operating margin of approximately 0.08% ($7 million). While the company maintains a marginally positive current ratio of 1.21 and positive shareholders' equity, its high leverage (total liabilities of $7.476 billion against total assets of $10.039 billion) and negligible operating profitability place it deep into speculative-grade territory. These factors indicate high credit risk and weak debt-servicing capacity, consistent with a highly speculative B-grade profile.

DECISION: B-
